title: Cloth grabbed and released — real Verlet rebound
story: Built a cloth simulation into the Studio because I could not stop thinking about how paper actually falls. The rebound is real Verlet physics, not an easing curve — you can grab it, fling it, and it settles differently every time. Nobody asked for this.
